en.headline: Symphony Orchestra Interflow opens at Cultural Centre with school ensembles
en.dek: The Music Office said about 60 primary and secondary school orchestras will perform from today until 25 November at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Concert Hall, with tickets at HK$80.
body: The Symphony Orchestra Interflow of the 2026 Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows begins today at the Concert Hall of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Organised by the Music Office of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the three-day event features about 60 school orchestras across primary and secondary school classes. Professional musicians serve as adjudicators, and awards will be presented.

Sessions run on 23, 24 and 25 November. Tickets cost HK$80, with half-price available for full-time students, seniors aged 60 or above, people with disabilities and their carers, and Comprehensive Social Security Assistance recipients. The event is part of youthfest@HK.
The broader Youth Music Interflows also include Chinese orchestra, symphonic band and string orchestra competitions later in November and December.

zh.headline: 青年音樂匯演交響樂團項目今日起在文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 音樂事務處表示，約60隊中小學樂團由今日至25日在香港文化中心音樂廳演出，門票80元。
body: 2026香港青年音樂匯演的交響樂團匯演今日起在尖沙咀香港文化中心音樂廳展開。
活動由康文署音樂事務處主辦，為期三天，約60隊中小學樂團分組參賽。專業音樂家擔任評判，並設獎項鼓勵。
演出日期為11月23日至25日。門票80元，全日制學生、60歲或以上長者、殘疾人士及其照顧者、綜援受惠者可享半價。活動屬youthfest@HK一部分。
整體青年音樂匯演還包括中樂團、管樂團及弦樂團項目，將於稍後月份舉行。
